caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet set against a plain, light-colored background. The cabinet features a warm brown and orange-toned wood grain throughout its surfaces, with four visible front-facing compartments: two upper drawers, each with a round wooden pull knob, and two lower hinged doors, each also fitted with matching round knobs. The bottom edge of the cabinet is shaped with a scalloped or curved decorative cutout. The side panels and front face of the cabinet show wood grain details and a slightly darker shading at the edges, indicating depth and shadow. The top of the cabinet has a decorative backboard with an arched and double-arched outline, also rendered in the same wood color as the rest of the piece. There are no other objects or decorative elements present in the composition.
title: Miniature Chest
